editorial:
Imagine you are stuck on a ten-hour flight from LA to Tokyo with nothing but a tiny seat and a few strangers. That is where you start in this creepy ride. You will follow a group of passengers who quickly realize they are not alone in the air. Something evil is on board, and it starts picking people off one by one. The vibe is super tense because there is nowhere to run. You feel the panic grow as the characters try to figure out why this is happening while trapped 30,000 feet in the sky.

The acting is solid and the scares are effective, though the story starts a bit slow. Once the chaos hits, it does not stop. If you like mysteries that make you guess who will survive, you will love this. Just make sure to turn off the lights and crank up the sound to get the full spooky effect.
endingExplained: You find out that a passenger brought a cursed object on the plane, which let a vengeful spirit loose. The ghost kills almost everyone by possessing them or attacking from the shadows. In the final moments, only a few people are left. The plane eventually crashes or lands in a state of total disaster. It turns out there was no way to stop the curse, leaving you with a bleak ending where the evil wins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and being scared in tight spaces.
